baseline_definition: A fresh Codex session receives the existing worktree after a hard transcript loss, but no durable task record or late steering.
caveats: This evaluates hard transcript-loss recovery, not native Codex or Claude session resume and not ordinary context compaction.
Each case was run once, so time and token differences are descriptive rather than statistically causal.
The first pass was executed by an agent system evaluating a control mechanism intended for agent systems; independent human review and reruns are required.
Three of five cases were quality ties because the baseline independently inferred the lost constraint.

evaluation_design.grader: Case-owned external tests fingerprinted before and after each run
